address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x3C`. The address is determined by the ADDR pin configuration on the sensor. Possible addresses: `0x38`, `0x3C`, `0x3E`, `0x3F`.

*See also: [STTS22H Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/stts22h#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) if you want to use multiple I²C buses.

*See also: [STTS22H Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/stts22h#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [STTS22H Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/stts22h#configuration-variables)*
